title: Indian specialty coffee roasters with sampler packs
description: Compare small coffee tasting packs from Indian roasters by bag size, selection and grind options.
intro: Sampler packs let you compare coffees before committing to a larger bag. This list focuses on packs with multiple coffees or roast styles, sold by the roasters themselves. Pack contents, price, delivery and stock can change by variant; check the product page before ordering. These descriptions are based on published product information, not a blind tasting or ranking.
